verified_facts: EA publishes related DTM products at multiple resolutions
DTM1m and DTM2m reference the same broad 2022 composite period
composite products combine timestamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat surveys use newest best-resolution data
same-area 1m and 2m values can share source survey lineage
shared lineage means those values are not automatically independent evidence
uncertainty combination must preserve correlation when source lineage overlaps
quality_effect: Stops multiresolution EA products derived from shared surveys being counted as independent corroboration.
